description:
The Amazon. An immense living organism, breathing on a scale large enough to form the atmosphere itself. 
Moisture rises from its canopy in invisible currents. Clouds form and fall again as rain, feeding rivers far beyond its borders. 
This is not just a forest. It is a system the world depends on.
